A '''clone trooper sergeant''' served in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], specifically in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] participated in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> and held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. The sergeant [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the battle.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the clone sergeant stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Enc" />

==Equipment==
The clone sergeant wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings on the arm, hand armor and helmet. In combat, the sergeant utilized a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="TCWf" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone sergeant first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2008]] animated theatrical film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] and was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced all other clone troopers in the film.<ref name="TCWf" />
